entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2610370969483589888: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112961: distance 118.064 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.078), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 118.064 +/- 9.209 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 8.9360 +/- 0.2356 mas (same row, RUWE 3.10), 37.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 14.964, 32.742 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2610370969483589888 (quality A), from 2009A&A...498..627F; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 98.304 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112961: radius 98.304 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 1630.73 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.103) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3702 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112961: effective temperature 3702 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.181).
